title: Canonical notation for scalar power quotient complexes
statement: For a site $(C,J)$ essentially small in the coefficient universe, a commutative ring sheaf $R$ and a global section $t$, retain the canonical constructions of [def-pe-principal-power-ring-quotients], [def-pur-principal-koszul-quotient-towers] and [def-cbc-regular-quotient-cone-basic]. For natural $n$, write $B_n=R/(t^{n+1})$, $p_n:R\to B_n$ for the projection, and $Q_n$ for the restricted regular $B_n$-module. Write single for concentration in degree zero, and twoTerm for the cone on the single of a scalar-power endomorphism. Let $P_{n,m}$ be this cone over $B_n$ for the image of $t^{m+1}$. Tensor means the total tensor $Q_n[0]\otimes_R K_m$. The coordinate inclusions are the single-coordinate inclusions followed by the corresponding cone inclusions, and the tensor inclusions use the inverse right unitor and the $(0,i)$ total-tensor summand inclusion. These are existing definitions relocated unchanged from the parent theorem module; no new quotient, module category or tensor product is defined.
